name: Room Icons
author: RobynTheDevil
description: Draws each locked room's unlock requirements as aspect icons on the map.
description_long:
Hush House shows a room's unlock cost only when you hover it for a moment or click into its detail window. Room Icons draws those requirements directly onto every locked, reachable room, so you can plan a route through the house at a glance.

[b]Reading the icons[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Solid group[/b] — essential aspects. You need [i]all[/i] of these.
[*][b]Dot-separated group[/b] — required principles. [i]Any one[/i] of them at its listed strength is enough.
[/list]

Icons scale up as you zoom out, holding their size on screen so the whole house stays readable from any distance. They disappear once a room is opened.

[b]Requirements[/b]
This is a DLL mod, so you must also subscribe to [b]Ghirbi, the Gatekeeper[/b] for it to load.
